comparison.objective: Threads an oil filter to gasket contact and then hand-tightens it by a bounded additional turn; the candidate adjusts and locks a gripper stop.
comparison.physical_skill: PR-1405 requires large-body grasping, multi-regrasp wrist rotation, and stopping by witnessed turns; the candidate requires coaxial tool seating and opposing torque.
comparison.success_condition: PR-1405 checks 240–360° past contact, no removal or overcompression, hand-driven rotation, and release; the candidate checks a 90° stop retained through three cycles.
comparison.reason: Controlled threaded rotation is generic; oil-filter installation has neither a separately preserved adjustment nor a jam nut.
